list.arch:
<tree default_order="perf_date desc" create="0">
                <field name="name" string="MAWB" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "required": true}"/>
                <field name="air_pol_id" string="POL"/>
                <field name="air_pod_id" string="POD"/>
                <field name="air_atd" widget="air_datetime"/>
                <field name="air_ata" widget="air_datetime"/>
                <field name="air_shipper_id" string="SHPR" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="air_consignee_id" string="CNEE" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="by_carrier_air_line_summary" string="CARRIER" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="partner_id" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="user_id" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="air_bound" optional="hide" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="perf_date"/>
                <field name="operator_ids" widget="many2many_tags" optional="hide"/>
<!--                <field name="priority" widget="priority"/>-->
                <field name="perf_date" modifiers="{"column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="company_id" optional="show" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
            </tree>

search.arch:
<search string="Shipments">
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="transport_mode"/>
                <field name="job_id"/>
                <field name="pic_id"/>
                <field name="user_id"/>
                <field name="port_receipt_id"/>
                <field name="port_delivery_id"/>
                <field name="sea_shipper_code" string="Shipper"/>
                <field name="operator_ids" widget="many2many_tags"/>
                <field name="consignee_id" string="Consignee" filter_domain="['|', '|', '|', '|', '|', ('sea_consignee_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('sea_consignee_id.partner_code', 'ilike', self), ('sea_consignee_id.vat', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.partner_code', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.vat', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="sea_house_bl_display_ids" string="House BL" filter_domain="['|',('air_house_bl_display_ids', 'ilike', self), ('sea_house_bl_display_ids', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <separator/>
                <filter string="Air Carriage" name="air_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'air')]"/>
                <filter string="Ocean Carriage" name="ocean_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'sea')]"/>
                <filter string="Land Carriage" name="land_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'land')]"/>
                <group expand="1" string="Group By">
                    <filter string="Transport Mode" name="group_by_transport_mode" context="{'group_by': 'transport_mode'}"/>
                    <filter string="Customer" name="group_by_customer" context="{'group_by': 'partner_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Shipper" name="group_by_sea_shipper" context="{'group_by': 'sea_shipper_code'}"/>
                    <filter string="Sale" name="group_by_user" context="{'group_by': 'user_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="PIC" name="group_by_pic" context="{'group_by': 'pic_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="State" name="group_by_state" context="{'group_by': 'state'}"/>
                </group>
            </search>
